# ona_runner_policy (Resource)

Grants a group a role on a runner. One resource per runner/group pair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ona_runner_policy" "platform_admin" {
  runner_id = ona_runner.example.id
  group_id  = ona_group.platform.id
  role      = "RUNNER_ROLE_ADMIN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group the role is granted to.
- `role` (String) Role granted to the group: `RUNNER_ROLE_ADMIN` or `RUNNER_ROLE_USER`.
- `runner_id` (String) Runner the group is granted access to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Policy identifier in the form `<runner-id>/<group-id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ona_runner_policy.platform_admin <runner-id>/<group-id>
```
